LanguageData.RWS_HospitalCuredDischargesDesc: Counts visiting hospital patients discharged alive after completing all required medical rest, tending, and scheduled surgeries in Hospital, excluding uncured danger evacuations and manual dismissals.
LanguageData.RWS_HospitalTreatmentSilverDesc: Counts total silver actually placed onto a player colony map when cured visiting patients pay for medical treatment upon discharge in Hospital.
LanguageData.RWS_RimatomicsSacsInterceptsDesc: Counts incoming hostile shells and projectiles destroyed in midair by player-owned HEL point-defense lasers in Dubs Rimatomics.
LanguageData.RWS_RimatomicsRailgunBombardmentsDesc: Counts intercontinental Punisher railgun sabot strikes launched from a player colony that reached and bombarded their world target in Dubs Rimatomics.
LanguageData.RWS_RimatomicsReactorScramsDesc: Counts emergency SCRAM shutdowns triggered on fueled, active player nuclear reactor cores in Dubs Rimatomics.
LanguageData.RWS_RimatomicsReactorMeltdownsDesc: Counts catastrophic nuclear core meltdowns occurring in player-owned reactor cores in Dubs Rimatomics.
LanguageData.RWS_AlteredCarbonSleeveGrowthDesc: Counts synthetic bodies grown to completion inside player-owned sleeve gestators in Altered Carbon 2: ReSleeved, broken down by pawn kind.
LanguageData.RWS_AlteredCarbonNeedlecastsDesc: Counts completed remote cortical stack consciousness transfers into living player target bodies in Altered Carbon 2: ReSleeved.
LanguageData.RWS_EmpireTaxDeliveredDesc: Counts total silver and market value of tax goods actually delivered onto a player map from vassal settlements in Empire Refactored, broken down by item type and excluding rescheduled deliveries.
LanguageData.RWS_AlphaGenesGeneAbsorptionsDesc: Counts genes newly absorbed onto living player casters via the Gene Syphon ability in Alpha Genes, broken down by absorbed gene.
LanguageData.RWS_AlphaGenesTeratogenicMutationsDesc: Counts teratogenic ability activations by player casters that consume carcinoma tumors and convert them into mutation buffs in Alpha Genes, broken down by resulting condition.
LanguageData.RWS_AlphaMechsBossKillsDesc: Counts cumulative kills of hostile apex bossgroup mechanoid commanders from Alpha Mechs on maps with colony presence, broken down by mechanoid kind.
LanguageData.RWS_VgeGravdataGainedDesc: Counts net newly earned gravdata from uncorrupted player gravship flight landings and orbital gravtech console research in Vanilla Gravship Expanded, excluding black box storage round-trips.
LanguageData.RWS_WorldDominationConquestsDesc: Counts non-player settlements conquered directly by player forces in World Domination 2.0, broken down by defeated faction and excluding AI-versus-AI wars.
LanguageData.RWS_WorldDominationPlayerVictoriesDesc: Counts offensive raid, outpost defense, and caravan clash victories won by player forces in World Domination 2.0, broken down by defeated enemy faction.
